summary.name: 0 A.D.
summary.one_liner: 0 A.D. (Empires Ascendant) is a free, open-source real-time strategy game of ancient warfare, developed by the volunteer Wildfire Games group, with Release 28 "Boiorix" adding a Germanic faction.
use_cases: Playing multiplayer matches with friends over the lobby or LAN
summary.what_it_does: The page announces Release 28 "Boiorix" of 0 A.D., a free, open-source historical RTS. Release 28 adds a Germans faction (Cimbri, Teutones, Ambrones) with supply wagons and siege units, and gendered civilian models replacing "female citizen" units. It switches fonts to on-the-fly FreeType rendering to reduce memory use and improve East Asian script support. It also adds game-setup options such as removing players and per-team population limits, and makes TLS certificate verification default in the multiplayer lobby. Balance changes cover naval units, capture resistance, champion cavalry and several factions.
notable: Free, open-source under GPL v2 (code) and CC-BY-SA 3.0 (artwork), with no freemium model or ads
Release 28 drops Windows 7/8.1 and macOS below 10.15 support, and adds a 64-bit Windows build
Linux builds include an AppImage alongside Snap and Flatpak maintainers' versions
Has 14 other factions to play against the new Germans
caveats: Windows 7 and 8.1 and macOS versions below 10.15 are no longer supported in Release 28
The 32-bit Windows build will eventually be deprecated
Mod creators need to port mods to the new version
